jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agents
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

We are looking for an exceptional engineer to join the Agents team and help shape the future of agentic computing. You'll work on the core abstractions and infrastructure that developers use to build sophisticated AI agents; from real-time voice and text interactions to durable workflows and agent-to-agent communication.

What You'll Do

  • Design and develop core functionality for the LiveKit Agents framework

  • Help define the text modality of the framework, enabling agents to interact with users across channels such as SMS

  • Design abstractions for stateful and durable agentic workflows, allowing agents to maintain state and coordinate work across interactions that may span minutes, hours, or longer

  • Shape agent-to-agent communication and delegation patterns, enabling voice agents to hand off tasks, collaborate, and compose into more sophisticated systems

  • Build simple, powerful developer APIs over complex distributed and real-time systems

  • Iterate quickly based on feedback from our developer community

  • Write clear documentation, examples, and reference implementations

  • Work primarily with Python and TypeScript

Who You Are

  • Experienced building LLM-based applications and agentic systems

  • Skilled at navigating complex systems and turning complexity into clean abstractions

  • Comfortable reasoning about state, concurrency and asynchronous workflows

  • Product-minded and excited about designing APIs and developer experiences

  • Experience building developer tools, frameworks, or SDKs is a plus

  • Interested in exploring emerging patterns in agent architecture rather than simply applying established ones

  • Comfortable working collaboratively in a remote environment

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Infrastructure Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

Our customers trust us with audio, video and data belonging to their own end users, so a security failure on our side puts their data and their business at risk. We are hiring an Infrastructure Security Engineer to improve the security posture of the production platform that carries that data. You will join a small Trust team that covers security, IT and compliance, and you will own real parts of the program from your first week. You will build our understanding of infrastructure security posture, then prioritize and drive remediation by business impact. Where the same class of problem keeps coming back, you will build the guardrails and security building blocks that let our security scale with the business.

You'll thrive at LiveKit if you

  • think like both a builder and a breaker, and understand security from first principles

  • take an automation-first and pragmatic approach to risk mitigation

  • translate security concerns into engineering action

  • can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

  • are a fast learner and thrive in ambiguity

What You’ll Do

  • Map the security posture of our cloud and production infrastructure and turn it into a documented baseline.

  • Find the gaps that could lead to customer data loss or infrastructure compromise, agree a prioritized security debt backlog with engineering, and close the highest-risk items first.

  • Harden identity, secrets and network boundaries, including cloud IAM, environment separation and credential hygiene.

  • Secure the infrastructure that runs customer-deployed voice AI agents: tenant isolation, secrets for third-party model providers, and media and recording storage.

  • Build guardrails and secure defaults into our infrastructure as code so the secure path is the easy one for engineers.

  • Partner with our Compliance team to map infrastructure controls to PCI-DSS and ISO 27001 and automate the technical evidence those audits depend on.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years in security engineering, infrastructure engineering or SRE, with a significant share of that focused on infrastructure security.

  • Hands-on experience securing a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP or Azure) and containerized workloads including Kubernetes.

  • A track record of owning infrastructure security for a production platform.

  • Fluency with infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and strong scripting and automation skills in a language such as Go or Python.

  • A pragmatic approach to risk: you can explain why a finding matters to the business and how fast it needs to be fixed.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time media, networking or WebRTC systems.

  • Experience in AI security, such as securing LLM applications or agent infrastructure.

  • Incident response or application security experience.

  • Experience supporting compliance audits such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2 or HIPAA.

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

Brand at LiveKit touches a lot more than the core identity. As the company grows, so does the range of things we’re designing — campaigns, events, billboards, keynotes, swag, launches, and everything in between.

We’re looking for a brand designer who’s excited by that range and can move comfortably between very different kinds of work. Someone with strong craft and taste, who can move quickly, explore a lot of ideas, and consistently make the work feel thoughtful and distinctly LiveKit.

You'll thrive as a Senior Brand Designer if you:

  • care deeply about the quality of the work and how it shows up in the world

  • are someone people trust to take on ambiguous, difficult design problems

  • move quickly and know how to get strong work shipped

  • have a high bar for craft, detail, and execution

  • are curious and constantly expanding your skills, references, and ways of working

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

What You'll Do

  • Lead campaigns from early concept through final execution across digital, print, and out-of-home

  • Own the creative direction and execution for events, from booth graphics and signage to environmental design and collateral

  • Build presentation systems that make sales, marketing, and keynote materials feel distinctly LiveKit

  • Extend the brand into new surfaces and formats without losing coherence

  • Design physical goods and swag that people actually want to keep and wear

  • Partner closely with marketing and sales to turn loose briefs into strong, shipped work quickly

Who You Are

  • A senior brand designer with strong work across a range of mediums, including campaigns, digital, print, out-of-home, environmental, and presentations

  • Experience taking campaign or advertising work from concept through production and into the real world

  • A systems thinker who can evolve and extend an identity, not just work within an existing system

  • Able to move quickly without compromising craft, detail, or quality

  • Actively experimenting with AI tools as part of your creative process, from early exploration through execution

Nice to Have

  • Strong motion sensibilities, even if you're not the one animating every frame

  • Time at developer-facing or design-forward companies

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

jobs.title: Design Engineer, Web/Brand
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

Developer-first companies are allergic to marketing — which means our web work has to be so good it doesn't feel like marketing. That's the job. Most "design engineer" roles are really front-end roles with a nicer title: implement the mockup, close the ticket. This one isn't. We're rolling out a new brand identity, and we need someone to engineer it into existence — the components, the motion systems, the tooling that make a brand real instead of a PDF nobody opens. You're the kind of person who profiles an animation at 10pm because 60fps wasn't negotiable, who notices when an easing curve is wrong from across the room, and who thinks the gap between "looks like the design" and "feels alive" is where the actual work lives.

You'll thrive as a Design Engineer if you:

  • obsess with crafting code that is fast, reliable and practical for the problem

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough technical problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful Issues and/or PRs on our Github repos 😊

What You'll Do

  • Own the craft of livekit.com — push the boundaries of what a developer-facing marketing site can be in motion, interaction, and performance

  • Engineer our new brand identity into a living system: components, motion patterns, and tooling that let the whole team ship on-brand work fast

  • Build launch pages, product pages, and campaign surfaces that hold an insanely high bar without slowing anyone down

  • Treat performance as a feature — rich experiences that stay fast, measured and defended with real budgets

  • Partner daily with brand designers, marketers, and the design engineering team to turn ambitious ideas into shipped web

Who You Are

  • An exceptional front-end engineer with a portfolio of production web work that speaks for itself

  • Obsessive about detail — motion, interaction, and performance are your home turf, not checkboxes

  • Fluent in translating brand and design intent into reusable systems and components

  • Fast and self-directed — you ship polished work without waiting for perfect specs

  • A strong collaborator with designers — you elevate their ideas rather than flattening them into what's easy

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a developer-tools, API, or infrastructure company — you know why engineers distrust marketing and how to win them over

  • WebGL, shaders, or creative-coding chops for the moments that call for something nobody's seen before

  • Design system contributions — tokens, primitives, docs that other people actually used

  • Battle scars from making a rich site pass Core Web Vitals — and strong opinions about how

  • You have a folder of screen recordings of other people's website interactions, purely for study (we won't judge)

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

LiveKit is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to work directly with customers building real-time communication and voice AI applications on the LiveKit platform.

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, and customer implementation. Forward Deployed Engineers partner closely with customers to design systems, prototype solutions, and solve complex technical challenges as teams move from experimentation to production.

You'll work alongside customers' engineering teams to help them successfully deploy and scale applications built on LiveKit — designing architectures, building integrations, debugging production issues, and developing reference implementations that demonstrate best practices.

This is an ideal role for engineers who enjoy solving real-world problems in real customer environments. You'll collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to surface insights from customer implementations and help shape the future of the LiveKit platform.

Your mission: make it seamless for developers to build and scale real-time audio, video, and AI applications on LiveKit.

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • are obsessed with helping developers succeed

  • are known as the go-to person for solving tricky technical issues

  • work hard and can move fast without sacrificing quality

  • care deeply about polish, detail, and clear communication

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tools, systems, and skills

What You'll Do

  • Work directly (remotely or on-site when necessary) with customer engineering teams to design and implement real-time applications built on LiveKit

  • Design scalable architectures for voice AI, real-time media, and developer platform use cases

  • Build prototype integrations, reference implementations, and sample applications to accelerate customer development

  • Help customers navigate SDKs, APIs, infrastructure, and deployment strategies for production systems

  • Debug and troubleshoot complex technical issues in production environments

  • Lead technical workshops and architecture sessions with developers and product teams

  • Translate customer needs into technical insights that inform product and platform development

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to improve developer experience, documentation, and tooling

  • Contribute code, examples, or improvements to LiveKit's open-source ecosystem when helpful

  • Act as a trusted advisor helping customers successfully launch and scale applications on LiveKit

Who You Are

  • Strong engineering background with 7+ years of experience in backend or infrastructure engineering

  • Proficient in one or more programming languages such as Go, Python, Node, Rust, or C++

  • Comfortable working across APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, and cloud infrastructure

  • Experience building or integrating developer platforms or real-time systems

  • Able to quickly understand complex systems and debug issues in real-world environments

  • Strong communicator who can collaborate directly with customer engineering teams and internal product teams

  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, low-process environments where ownership and initiative matter

  • Excited to work hands-on with customers solving complex technical implementation challenges

Nice to Have

  • Experience with WebRTC, real-time media systems, or telephony/SIP infrastructure

  • Familiarity with voice AI, conversational agents, or AI infrastructure

  • Experience working in customer-facing engineering roles such as Solutions Engineer, Field Engineer, or Forward Deployed Engineer

  • Experience contributing to open-source projects or developer ecosystems

  • Previous experience building with or integrating LiveKit

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

We are hiring across multiple levels (Forward Deployed Engineer, Senior FDE, and Staff FDE). Compensation will be determined by experience, technical depth, and interview performance.

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Distributed Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is revolutionizing the AI landscape by providing the essential network infrastructure that powers multimodal AI interfaces, enabling seamless audio and visual interactions. Founded in 2021, LiveKit has rapidly grown to support over 3 Billion calls annually, 100,000+ developers globally, and industry giants like OpenAI, Character AI, Spotify, and Meta.

About This Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to work across some of the most technically demanding parts of LiveKit's platform — core services, telephony, and observability. At LiveKit, the infrastructure is the product — you're not building the layer underneath, you are the layer.

You'll work on problems where latency, availability, and operational simplicity are critical, and where the right answer often requires careful tradeoffs and outside-the-box thinking. While distributed systems experience is valuable, we care just as much about strong programming fundamentals, sound judgment, and the ability to learn fast. The team is small. Your decisions ship directly into production.

You'll thrive as a Distributed Systems Engineer if you:

  • obsess with crafting code that is fast, reliable and practical for the problem

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough technical problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful Issues and/or PRs on our Github repos 😊

What You'll Do

  • Design and evolve the core control, data, and observability systems that power LiveKit Cloud

  • Implement resilient, region-spanning architectures that degrade gracefully under partial failure

  • Build libraries, protocols, and tooling that raise reliability and developer velocity across the org

  • Diagnose and harden critical paths using metrics, tracing, testing, and real-world traffic insights

  • Shape new platform capabilities across identity, scheduling, observability, and distributed state management

  • Technologies include: Go, psrpc, gRPC, Raft, NATS, Kubernetes, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse

Who You Are

  • You have experience designing and delivering distributed systems in production

  • You take ownership end-to-end - prototype, test, ship, monitor, and iterate

  • You're comfortable with consensus, coordination, and the realities of distributed failure modes

  • You think in terms of data flow, state, performance, and correctness, and you can reduce complex systems into understandable components

  • You value clear communication, practical engineering, and building systems that others enjoy working with

Nice to Have

  • Go fluency — if you haven't written Go yet, you've been meaning to

  • Hands-on experience with pub/sub, RPC, or coordination systems (NATS, etcd, Raft, Paxos)

  • Exposure to real-time or low-latency infrastructure — you know what microseconds feel like

  • You've shipped observability tooling you'd actually want to use (tracing, metrics, at-scale logging)

  • In those school group projects, you did most of the work (:sigh:)

We offer

  • The opportunity to shape the brand of a fast-growing developer platform

  • Collaboration with a small, senior team that deeply values craft and creativity

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

The things you ship are built from deep knowledge of actual customer use-cases, and you continuously measure, seek feedback, and iterate to maximize your impact.

This role can be based remotely or in our SF HQ, where you'll be part of a collaborative in-office culture!

You'll Thrive at LiveKit if You

  • are genuinely excited about agentic and AI-native applications and want to build the infrastructure that makes them possible

  • love building for developers and have strong opinions about what good DX looks like

  • write code that's fast, reliable, and right-sized to the problem

  • own what you ship you feel it when something you built isn't working for users

  • move fast without losing rigor on the details that matter

  • can explain complex technical concepts clearly to other engineers

  • pick up new languages, tools, and domains quickly

What You'll Do

  • Build and ship core product surfaces end to end, primarily on the web and in our CLI

  • Design and implement features that make LiveKit feel obvious and powerful to the developers using it

  • Engage directly with developers and customers to understand how they're building with LiveKit and where the rough edges are

  • Move quickly from prototype to production, iterating on real usage rather than guesses

  • Contribute to technical and product decisions that shape what we build next

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of engineering experience, with meaningful time spent shipping product end-to-end

  • Strong coding skills in TypeScript, with fluency in modern web frameworks. Comfort with Go is a plus.

  • A track record of building user-facing software that developers or technical users actually adopted

  • Strong product sense: you weigh user experience, trade-offs, and value alongside technical implementation

  • Comfort with ambiguity. You can take a vague problem, frame it, and start shipping.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication

  • Genuine excitement about agentic AI, voice, and the next generation of developer platforms

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with and operating production distributed systems (Kubernetes-based deployments, analytics/telemetry, and observability) at scale

  • Open source contributions, especially on infra or developer tools

  • Background in realtime, audio/video, or AI tooling

  • Based in or willing to spend time in the San Francisco Bay Area

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

jobs.title: GTM Systems Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About You

The GTM Systems Engineer at LiveKit owns the infrastructure layer that makes the entire revenue engine work — and builds the automation and agentic workflows that run on top of it. Systems engineering is at the core of this role, but it doesn't stop there. You're equally comfortable architecting Salesforce as a trusted source of truth and building the outbound workflows, enrichment pipelines, and AI-driven automations that help the GTM team move faster and smarter.

Salesforce is our system of record — it holds the bulk of our GTM data and is the source of truth for revenue, pipeline, and customer data. HubSpot is our marketing layer for campaigns and lead gen, and what it captures needs to flow cleanly and reliably into Salesforce. Both systems are in place. What we're building now is the engineering layer that makes all of it trustworthy and intelligent: real change management, observable pipelines, data models built for AI consumption, and agentic workflows that act on GTM signals at scale.

You understand the difference between owning a system and gatekeeping one. Sales lives in Salesforce. Marketing lives in HubSpot. Your job is to make sure both are governed well enough that others can work in them effectively — and powerful enough that the GTM team can do things they couldn't do before.

You'll thrive as a GTM Systems Engineer if you:

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough technical problems

  • can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

  • you believe systems should be managed with engineering discipline

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools

What You'll Do

  • Own Salesforce as the engineering system of record for revenue: data model, custom objects and fields, flows and automation, validation rules, field governance, and access control. Salesforce is the source of truth — everything else flows into or out of it.

  • Own HubSpot as the marketing system for campaigns and lead gen, and own the HubSpot-Salesforce sync — ensuring leads, contacts, and engagement signals flow accurately from Marketing into the revenue pipeline without drift or silent failures.

  • Build and maintain integrations across the GTM stack (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Clay, Common Room, billing platform, and more) — ensuring data, engagement signals, and activity flow accurately without silent failures.

  • Partner with the GTM Analytics Engineering team to ensuring data is flowing from our GTM systems to the central Data Platform.

  • Build, deploy, and extend agentic workflows: AI agents that consume GTM data, surface actionable signals, and automate operations that used to require a human — as part of LiveKit's Data and Business Systems Platform.

  • Build and maintain observability for critical GTM systems: dashboards, alerts, and runbooks so you know when something is wrong before Sales or Marketing does.

  • Implement proper change management across both CRMs: code changes go through review, config changes are documented, rollback paths exist.

  • Partner with SalesOps and Marketing to ensure both GTM orgs can work effectively in their respective systems — your job is keeping the foundation trustworthy and accessible, not being a ticket queue.

  • Partner with the Billing Systems Engineer on CPQ-to-Billing workflows — ensuring the closed-won-to-billing handoff is automated and accurate.

Who You Are

  • Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise — you understand the data model, have built complex flows and automation, and you think about it as an engineering system, not an admin tool. This is the primary bar.

  • HubSpot experience in a marketing context — you've owned or operated it for campaigns and lead gen, and you've managed the HubSpot-Salesforce sync, including what breaks and why.

  • Integration engineering experience — you've built and/or maintained integrations using APIs, webhooks, and event streams, and you've handled what happens when they break silently.

  • Technical depth beyond the UI — you're comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and scripting, and you know when a native tool (a Flow, a Clay table, a HubSpot workflow) is the right answer versus when it's time to write code.

  • Agentic workflow experience — you've built or extended AI agent workflows that act on GTM data. Not "we used AI tools" but actually designed and deployed agents in production.

  • Strong change management practices — you've managed deployments in live systems where a mistake breaks active deals or campaigns.

  • Comfortable partnering with Sales and Marketing stakeholders directly — fluent in both worlds, able to translate their needs into system requirements without becoming a bottleneck.

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce CPQ: approvals, order forms, discounting rules, and the closed-won-to-billing path.

  • SQL and data modeling fluency; familiarity with a warehouse-centric stack (BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, reverse ETL).

  • Experience with billing platforms (Stripe, Zuora, Maxio) and the handoffs between GTM systems and billing.

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

This isn't one of those situations where we tack "engineer" onto the back of every role at LiveKit. No. We're actually looking for an engineer*. A rare type of engineer that cares about talking to and advocating for customers, helping unblock them by fixing bugs or writing up sample code, and providing customers with guidance, pointers and support.

We say rare because in our experience, most engineers aspire to architect large-scale systems or tackle deeply technical problems. Said differently, most engineers want to have influence over the technology they work on or with. There's nothing wrong with that — we love hardcore engineers, and there are many at LiveKit. But this time, we're looking for a new teammate that wants to have influence over our product and business.

If you'd be energized by seeing a developer or team flip a LiveKit integration from staging to production — secretly satisfied in knowing you helped make it possible — you are perfect for this.

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • are an engineer at heart, and don't mind reading more code than you write

  • are a natural teacher who finds joy in helping others learn and succeed

  • can break down complex technical concepts in a way that's easily understood by others

  • enjoy learning new programming languages quickly and prototyping

  • care deeply about the developer experience and the success of the people building on our platform

  • have excellent spoken and written English

What You'll Do

  • Support and work directly with developers, teams, and companies building with LiveKit, both commercially and in the community

  • Triage, file, and fix bugs, respond to support tickets, write sample and production-quality code, and update documentation and technical guides in service of customers

  • Regularly meet with and follow up with LiveKit customers to ensure their continued success on the platform

  • Partner closely with Sales, BD, and Partnerships teams on strategy and support them in customer conversations

  • A practicing engineer with demonstrated ability to build, ship, and debug production software

  • Comfortable working across an unfamiliar codebase to diagnose and resolve customer issues

  • A clear written and verbal communicator who can adapt your message to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Curious, fast-learning, and energized by ambiguity

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

jobs.title: Staff Developer Advocate, Community & Events
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About You

LiveKit is seeking a Staff Developer Advocate to help grow our presence and deepen engagement with developers, with a strong focus on events and community building. You’ll be the face of LiveKit in the Bay Area and beyond, driving awareness with developers who may not yet know us, and creating experiences that inspire them to build with real-time audio and video.

This role is a hybrid of content creation and event execution: you’ll organize and host events, speak at meetups and conferences, and also create supporting content that extends the reach of those activities. You’ll bring back insights from the community—trends, patterns, and narratives that are top of mind for developers—and use them to inform our product, messaging, and broader DevRel strategy.

What You’ll Do

  • Drive awareness of LiveKit with new developer audiences, especially in the Bay Area where there is a significant opportunity to grow our presence.

  • Plan, host, and participate in events including meetups, hackathons, developer workshops, and conferences.

  • Partner with Marketing to amplify events through digital channels, ensuring broader reach and sustained impact.

  • Create content from events (recaps, demos, tutorials, blogs, social posts) to expand engagement beyond the room.

  • Serve as a feedback loop for the company, bringing back developer perspectives, industry trends, and emerging patterns to inform our product and community strategy.

  • Represent LiveKit on stage and in community forums, speaking authentically to developer audiences about our technology.

  • Help experiment with new event formats and engagement tactics, testing what resonates most with our audience.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with DevRel, PMM, and Product to ensure developer narratives are consistent, compelling, and authentic.

Who You Are

  • 2+ years of experience in Developer Advocacy, Developer Relations, or Technical Evangelism, with a strong emphasis on events and community engagement.

  • Comfortable being outward-facing—you enjoy speaking to groups, hosting sessions, and building relationships in developer communities.

  • Strong technical communication skills; you can explain complex concepts in clear, engaging ways across presentations and written content.

  • Hands-on technical background (comfortable writing code samples, running demos, or building prototypes).

  • Experience planning and executing developer events (e.g., meetups, hackathons, workshops, or conference tracks).

  • Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with willingness to travel for conferences and events.

  • Strong collaborator who can work cross-functionally with Marketing, Product, and Engineering.

  • Curious and empathetic—you love learning what matters most to developers and bringing those insights back to the team.

Our Commitments to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Work anywhere in the world

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about championing developers in the realm of real-time communications and want to make a significant impact at a high-growth company, we'd love to hear from you. At LiveKit, your work as a Developer Advocate will be instrumental in our growth and success, bridging the gap between our technology and the developers who use it.

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

About This Role

Most company social accounts talking to developers get ignored — or worse, screenshotted for the wrong reasons. Developers can smell marketing from three timelines away, which means the only way to do this job well is to actually be one of them: someone who reads the model release notes for fun, has opinions about agent frameworks, and knows the difference between a post that earns a reply and one that earns a mute. We're not looking for a social media manager who can learn tech. We're looking for someone deep in the agentic AI world who happens to be exceptional at making the internet care.

You'll thrive as a Senior Developer Advocate if you:

  • are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • are focused on polish, detail and quality

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

  • Turn product launches into social campaigns that reach and excite developers, from the first teaser to the launch-day thread

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Distributed Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is revolutionizing the AI landscape by providing the essential network infrastructure that powers multimodal AI interfaces, enabling seamless audio and visual interactions. Founded in 2021, LiveKit has rapidly grown to support over 3 Billion calls annually, 100,000+ developers globally, and industry giants like OpenAI, Character AI, Spotify, and Meta.

About This Role

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to work across some of the most technically demanding parts of LiveKit's platform — core services, telephony, and observability. At LiveKit, the infrastructure is the product — you're not building the layer underneath, you are the layer.

You'll work on problems where latency, availability, and operational simplicity are critical, and where the right answer often requires careful tradeoffs and outside-the-box thinking. While distributed systems experience is valuable, we care just as much about strong programming fundamentals, sound judgment, and the ability to learn fast. The team is small. Your decisions ship directly into production.

You'll thrive as a Distributed Systems Engineer if you:

  • obsess with crafting code that is fast, reliable and practical for the problem

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough technical problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful Issues and/or PRs on our Github repos 😊

What You'll Do

  • Design and evolve the core control, data, and observability systems that power LiveKit Cloud

  • Implement resilient, region-spanning architectures that degrade gracefully under partial failure

  • Build libraries, protocols, and tooling that raise reliability and developer velocity across the org

  • Diagnose and harden critical paths using metrics, tracing, testing, and real-world traffic insights

  • Shape new platform capabilities across identity, scheduling, observability, and distributed state management

  • Technologies include: Go, psrpc, gRPC, Raft, NATS, Kubernetes, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, ClickHouse

Who You Are

  • You have experience designing and delivering distributed systems in production

  • You take ownership end-to-end - prototype, test, ship, monitor, and iterate

  • You're comfortable with consensus, coordination, and the realities of distributed failure modes

  • You think in terms of data flow, state, performance, and correctness, and you can reduce complex systems into understandable components

  • You value clear communication, practical engineering, and building systems that others enjoy working with

Nice to Have

jobs.title: IT Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About You

This is an engineering role with a support component, not the other way around. The bulk of the job is building and owning systems: the identity model in Okta, endpoint baselines in Workspace ONE, governance across Google Workspace and the wider SaaS estate, and the automation that determines how much manual work IT has to absorb in the first place. You'll also carry escalations and some direct support — at our size there's no clean wall between the two, and the person in this role needs to stay close enough to the queue to know which problems are worth engineering away.

You'll work in an Okta, Workspace ONE, Google Workspace, and Slack stack, partnered closely with Security, Engineering, People, and Finance. Internal systems are in audit scope for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI, so the controls you build have to hold up under an auditor's review, not just function day to day.

You'll thrive as an IT Engineer if you:

  • obsess with crafting code that is fast, reliable and practical for the problem

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough technical problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools

What You'll Do

  • As an IT Engineer at LiveKit, you will:

    • Own identity and access engineering in Okta — group strategy, app assignments, SSO configuration, lifecycle automation, and access request patterns that are secure without being miserable to use

    • Run endpoint engineering across a macOS-first fleet in Workspace ONE — provisioning, configuration baselines, patching, encryption posture, inventory hygiene, and compliance reporting

    • Administer Google Workspace and Slack at scale: user lifecycle, groups, shared drives, permissions, roles, and the governance patterns that keep them from drifting

    • Bring the SaaS estate under real governance — who owns each tool, who has access, what it costs, and what happens to all three when someone changes teams or leaves

    • Build the automation that keeps IT load from scaling with headcount — onboarding, deprovisioning, access reporting, device compliance, and whatever else you catch yourself doing twice

    • Translate security, compliance, and engineering requirements into IT controls that generate their own audit evidence instead of a quarterly scramble

    • Serve as the technical escalation point for complex issues across identity, access, endpoints, and internal infrastructure — and then engineer the class of problem out of existence

Who You Are

  • 4+ years in IT engineering, IT operations, systems administration, endpoint engineering, or identity engineering — ideally somewhere fast-moving and remote-first

  • You've administered Okta or a comparable identity provider as the owner: SSO, groups, app assignments, lifecycle workflows, real access management decisions

  • Hands-on with modern MDM — Workspace ONE or equivalent — including provisioning, configuration enforcement, patching, encryption, and inventory

  • Strong Google Workspace administration and genuine macOS endpoint depth

  • You've built or meaningfully improved operational workflows, automation, reporting, or internal controls — not just operated someone else's

  • An excellent writer. You can explain a technical decision clearly, document a system so the next person doesn't have to reverse-engineer it, and keep stakeholders informed without burying them

  • Strong ownership and judgment. You can prioritize under ambiguity and you build things that reduce future work rather than adding to it

  • You want to stay hands-on. This is an individual contributor role, and the work is building and operating systems, not managing people who do

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting security and compliance work — SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI, access reviews, audit evidence, or control implementation

  • Fluency with device security posture: EDR, disk encryption, patch compliance, vulnerability management, access hygiene

  • Scripting and automation with Bash, Python, Google Apps Script, Okta Workflows, or raw APIs

  • Experience designing IT processes that work across time zones for a globally distributed team, including the particular joy of international hardware logistics

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Work alongside world-class engineers building in the open

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

  • Remote work environment with the equipment you need

Ready to Apply?

If the idea of owning identity, endpoints, and automation end to end sounds like your kind of job, we'd love to hear from you.

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

We're looking for the first Product Manager for LiveKit Telephony: how AI agents utilize the global phone network. Landlines, mobile networks, and enterprise phone systems already connect nearly every person and business on earth. Making an agent a first-class participant on that network is what turns voice AI from a demo into something that picks up a real phone number and does real work.

Our PM team is small and high-leverage, with each PM coming in to establish the foundations in a new area of the business. Telephony is essential to many of the highest-value voice AI use cases running today: call centers, customer support, healthcare triage, outbound sales, appointment scheduling. A large share of our growth comes from enterprises putting agents on the phone at massive volume, and every one of those calls runs through this product.

You'll shape the direction and roadmap for Telephony alongside the engineering leaders who build it, across both sides of the product. On one side is SIP trunking, where enterprises bring the carriers and phone systems they already have and everything has to interoperate, stay up, and sound good. On the other is LiveKit Phone Numbers, our native offering, where we own the carrier relationships and hand a developer a working number in a couple of clicks. Going native lets us control the whole path a call takes, which means fewer hops, better audio, and quality we can actually tune. We intend to offer the fastest and best sounding connection an agent can get, anywhere in the world, and you'll decide how quickly we get there and how far the footprint reaches.

This role can be based remotely or in our SF HQ, where you'll be part of a collaborative in-office culture!

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • are focused on polish, detail, and quality

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is by trying LiveKit's product, understanding the space, and bringing smart thoughts and opinions to the table.

What You'll Do

  • Own the telephony roadmap. Build a clear point of view on where the product is going, and decide what gets built and when, in partnership with engineering.

  • Meet enterprises where they are. SIP has as many interpretations as there are vendors. Decide what compatibility we take on, and when, so connecting an existing carrier, PBX, or contact center platform is straightforward instead of a project.

  • Take native telephony global. Extend LiveKit Phone Numbers well beyond its US starting point, with the country coverage and regulatory footing to make buying a number from us the obvious choice.

  • Get deep with customers and data. Understand how teams actually run phone-based agents in production, from the first trunk they configure to the calls that go wrong, and let that shape priorities.

  • Own the economics. Telephony is already a meaningful business with real carrier costs behind it. Own pricing, packaging, and margin as volume grows and our footprint expands.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years in product management, at a senior or staff level, with substantial experience managing a developer-facing products in particular.

  • Technical depth. You can reason about protocols, media paths, latency, call quality, and failure modes, and earn the trust of strong engineers. You don't need to write code, but you need to understand systems well enough to make good tradeoffs.

  • Reliability instincts. You've owned a product where uptime and quality were the core of the job, and you're comfortable in a domain where failure is immediate and obvious to a person on the other end of a live call.

  • Cross-functional influence. You influence through clarity, trust, and good judgment, not process or hierarchy.

  • Customer obsessed. You form deep connection with customer needs, and translate that into the prioritized roadmap with the engineering team. You ensure everything we ship is polished, focused, and solves real problems for customers.

  • Communication as a superpower. You write clearly, present well, and can move between a board-level strategy conversation and a detailed technical discussion with an engineering lead.

  • Comfort with ambiguity. We're a small product team at a fast-growing company. You'll figure out what matters, prioritize ruthlessly, and move quickly without perfect information.

Nice to Have

  • Built a telephony, CPaaS, SIP, or voice communications product that customers ran production call volume on

  • Familiarity with SIP, RTP/SRTP, DTMF, voice codecs, and call transfer

  • Experience working with carriers: interconnects, number provisioning and porting, and telecom regulation and compliance

  • Background at a developer tools, infrastructure, or communications company

  • Familiarity with voice AI, real-time communication, or contact center platforms

  • Experience with usage-based pricing models and cost or margin optimization

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About You

Our revenue is credit-denominated and consumption-based — usage billing, prepaid credit drawdown, and concurrency pricing across a growing enterprise base — which is close to the most complex revenue profile in infrastructure software. The load-bearing questions are open and there are few set policies and processes.

You will be the technical authority on revenue. You will own the entire Order to Cash cycle, from interfacing with our sales team, reviewing contracts, assessing terms in accordance with ASC 606, implementing workpapers and schedules, documenting conclusions, and assisting with billing and collection efforts. If building processes from square one and taking ownership of some of the most complex revenue arrangements excites you, this is the role for you.

You'll thrive as a Revenue Accounting Manager if you:

  • are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

  • work hard and can build and ship fast

  • are focused on polish, detail and quality

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

What You'll Do

  • Author our revenue accounting policy set — principal versus agent on brokered inference, breakage on expiring credits, performance obligation identification and allocation, minimum commitment versus overage, and contract modifications — and make each one stand up to an external auditor

You'll work directly with senior leaders to shape the GTM systems roadmap, turn business strategy into technical plans, and guide decisions that span multiple teams. You'll also help grow the engineers around you, setting the technical standards and practices the team builds on.

You understand the difference between owning a system and gatekeeping one. Sales lives in Salesforce. Marketing lives in HubSpot. Your job is to make sure both are governed well enough that others can work in them effectively, and powerful enough that the GTM team can do things they couldn't do before.

  • Are known as the go-to person for tough technical problems, and have good judgment about which ones matter most.

  • Think in systems and long time horizons, and can make confident architectural decisions with incomplete information.

  • Can clearly explain complex technical concepts and tradeoffs to engineers and executives alike.

  • Believe systems should be managed with engineering discipline.

  • Ship fast and reliably — your work holds up in production.

  • Are a fast learner, frequently picking up new languages and tools.

  • Find real satisfaction in mentoring other engineers and helping them grow.

 

What You'll Do

  • Own the architecture of the GTM systems stack: define how Salesforce, HubSpot, enrichment, sales intelligence, billing, and the data platform fit together, and write the technical strategy that guides how it evolves.

  • Lead build-vs-buy and procurement decisions: evaluate vendors, run proofs of concept, assess security and integration fit, and partner with Director of GTM Systems and Analytics, Finance, Legal, and IT on selection and renewals.

  • Shape the GTM systems roadmap with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and Engineering: align on requirements, sequence investments, make clear tradeoffs, and lead cross-functional initiatives to completion.

  • Own Salesforce as the engineering system of record for revenue: data model, flows and automation, validation rules, field governance, and access control.

  • Own HubSpot for campaigns and lead generation, along with the HubSpot-Salesforce sync — so leads, contacts, and engagement signals reach the revenue pipeline without drift or silent failures.

  • Build and maintain integrations across the GTM stack, and partner with GTM Analytics Engineering on reliable data flows to the central data platform.

  • Design and deploy agentic workflows that consume GTM data, surface actionable signals, and automate manual operations — and set the patterns and guardrails others build on.

  • Establish observability and change management for critical GTM systems: alerts, dashboards, and runbooks; reviewed code changes, documented config, and rollback paths.

  • Mentor engineers across experience levels and set the technical standards for the team.

  • Partner with the Billing Systems Engineer to automate the CPQ-to-Billing handoff.

 

Who You Are

  • Extensive engineering experience in GTM or business systems, including owning a GTM stack's architecture end to end — build-vs-buy calls, vendor evaluations, and systems designed for a multi-year horizon.

  • Deep, hands-on Salesforce expertise — you understand the data model, have built complex flows and automation, and you think about it as an engineering system, not an admin tool. This is the primary bar.

  • HubSpot experience in a marketing context, including the HubSpot-Salesforce sync and what breaks and why.

  • Technical depth beyond the UI — you've built integrations with APIs, webhooks, and event streams, and you know when a native tool (a Flow, a Clay table, a HubSpot workflow) is the right answer versus when it's time to write code.

  • Agentic workflow experience — you've designed and deployed AI agents that act on GTM data in production.

  • Strong change management practices — you've shipped changes to live systems while protecting active deals and campaigns.

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders — translating business strategy into system requirements and roadmaps.

  • A history of mentoring engineers, from early-career to senior.

 

Nice to Have

  • Salesforce CPQ: approvals, order forms, discounting rules, and the closed-won-to-billing path.

  • SQL and data modeling fluency; familiarity with a warehouse-centric stack (BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, reverse ETL).

  • Experience with billing platforms (Stripe, Zuora, Maxio) and the handoffs between GTM systems and billing.

  • Experience managing a GTM tooling budget or vendor portfolio.

  • Experience as a technical lead on a GTM or business systems team.

 

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

 

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for tens of thousands of developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year: language tutors that talk back, customer support and sales agents running real call volume, healthcare intake, coaching and training software, in-game characters, and the voice and video layer for robots.

About This Role

We're looking for our first Product Operations Manager. Our product team is small, senior, and growing fast, with each PM coming in to establish the foundations of a new part of the business. As the team grows, the work that connects it (how we plan, set and measure goals, keep the roadmap honest, run our rituals, learn from customers, and bring new people up to speed) needs an owner.

This role is that owner. Your customers are the PMs and the head of product, and your job is to make them faster and better at what they do. You won't be inheriting a process manual or enforcing one. You'll be designing how a product team works at the moment it goes from a handful of people to a real organization, inside an engineering culture that values autonomy and only adopts what makes people's lives easier.

You'll Thrive Here If You:

  • see the people you support as customers, and start from their problems rather than from a framework

  • like building systems from scratch more than maintaining them

  • would rather remove a meeting than add one

  • write clearly and enjoy making complicated things legible

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tools and techniques, including AI

The best way to impress us is by trying LiveKit's product, understanding how we work, and bringing smart thoughts and opinions to the table.

What You'll Do

  • Run the product team's operating cadence. You own the calendar of planning cycles, reviews, and recurring updates: what each one is for, who needs to be there, what goes in, and what comes out. You make sure decisions and follow-ups are captured and visible to everyone who needs them, and you keep retiring or reshaping rituals that stop earning their time.

  • Own the roadmap as a system. You own how the roadmap is structured, at the right altitude for each audience, from engineering teams to leadership to sales. You make sure it stays current and becomes the place people go to find out what we're building and where it stands.

  • Make goals and progress visible. You run goal-setting for the product team so that every goal is measurable against a clear source of truth, and you track progress against those goals through the quarter. With our data team, you own the reporting the product team and leadership rely on, and you flag drift early.

  • Keep the product development playbook. You maintain lightweight shared standards for each step from framing a problem through launch: problem briefs, launch readiness, product stage definitions, release notes. With marketing, you run the internal side of every launch so each one ships with docs, pricing, and GTM ready.

  • Run the customer insight engine. You own the systems that keep customers close to the product team: a research repository people use, a continuous pipeline of customer conversations set up with sales and success, and a steady synthesis of what we hear from sales, support, surveys, and deals, delivered to the PMs who need it.

  • Grow the craft of the PM team. You own onboarding for new PMs, ongoing training, and the team's community of practice, and you help shape how we hire and level PMs.

  • Choose and run the team's tools. You decide how the product team uses its tools, from roadmapping and analytics to AI, and you make sure PMs get real leverage from them.

  • Be a partner in running the product org. You keep a pulse on where the team is stuck, bring your own point of view on what to fix next, and work with the head of product to make the product org better every quarter.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years of experience, with at least 3 in product operations or a closely related role (chief of staff to a product leader, product program management, product strategy and operations) supporting a product team.

  • You've built it before. You've designed a product team's operating cadence from scratch at a company that was scaling, not only kept an existing one running.

  • A force multiplier. You measure your success by what changed for the people you support, not by how much process exists.

  • A strong writer. Most of what this role produces is read by other people: templates, updates, plans, and documentation.

  • Data fluent. You're comfortable defining metrics, working in BI tools, and telling a trustworthy number from an untrustworthy one. SQL is a plus.

  • Technical enough for a developer company. Our customers are developers and our organization is engineering-led. You don't need to write code, but you need to be credible with the people who do.

  • Influence without authority. Our engineering teams operate with high autonomy. Nothing here works by mandate; it works because it's useful.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools heavily in your own work and can help others do the same.

Nice to Have

  • Product operations experience at a developer tools, API, infrastructure, or AI company

  • Ran quarterly planning or OKRs for a product organization

  • Built a research repository or a customer recruiting program for B2B research

  • Built a PM onboarding program or career ladder

  • Worked with go-to-market teams on launch readiness and product stage definitions

  • Experience as a product manager

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the agentic era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe AI agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice and agentic AI applications for OpenAI, Salesforce, Spotify, Meta, and tens of thousands of other developers, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

 

About This Role

We're hiring a Solutions Architect (Pre-Sales) to be the technical partner to the engineers and enterprises building on LiveKit.

You'll work alongside an account executive to understand what a customer is trying to build, design the right architecture, and bring it to life with live demos and proofs-of-concept — guiding teams from first conversation to production.

This role is ideal for someone who loves to build, is energized by talking with other engineers, and takes pride in turning a hard technical problem into something that just works. Real-time voice and video is visceral — latency, quality, and reliability are felt, not read about — so the best conversations include something live. You'll collaborate closely with our Sales, Engineering, Product teams to win technical decisions and to make sure what you hear in the field informs how we build.

You'll thrive here if you:

  • love to build and solve the most challenging customer problems with LiveKit

  • have a curious mind with a continuous desire to learn and improve

  • enjoy demoing and presenting, whether to a room or engineer, to a CTO or at a conference

  • have a team first mentality, seeking to lift others around you as you progress in your career

 

What You'll Do

  • Partner with an account executive as the technical lead on strategic deals — from discovery and architecture design through demos, POCs, and technical decisions

  • Advise customers on cloud architecture and deployment across self-hosted and LiveKit Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Build live demos and reference applications — voice agents, video pipelines, telephony integrations — tailored to each customer's use case, and reusable by the wider team

  • Scope and run proofs-of-concept against clear, shared success criteria, guiding customers all the way to production

  • Reason with customers about connectivity, infrastructure, and end-to-end latency to design for scale and reliability

  • Create technical content — blog posts, guides, webinars, and conference talks — that helps developers and enterprises build with LiveKit

  • Act as the technical enabler for your region's pod, and share field insight with Product and Engineering to help shape the roadmap

 

Who You Are

  • 4+ years in solutions architecture, sales engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role (or equivalent hands-on engineering experience with strong customer instincts)

  • Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — you can architect, deploy, and debug real applications

  • Comfortable with the modern deployment toolchain: containers, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and networking fundamentals (load balancing, DNS, firewalls/NAT)

  • Able to reason about connectivity, infrastructure, and latency end to end — how architecture, network path, compute, co-location, and model choice shape the AI agentic experiences of today

  • Strong programming ability in at least one of our core SDK languages — Python, TypeScript/Node, or Go

  • A clear communicator who can demo, present, and write for technical audiences

 

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of real-time media protocols and their latency/quality trade-offs (WebRTC, RTP/SRTP, WebSockets)

  • Familiarity with the AI voice stack: STT/TTS providers, LLM integration, speech-to-speech models, turn detection, and telephony/SIP

  • Experience speaking at meetups or conferences, or a track record of technical writing or open-source contributions

 

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

 

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. About This Role:

A lot of technical recruiting jobs at startups are a sprint: a big hiring push, a pile of reqs, then a hiring freeze and a reorg. This isn't that. Our engineering hiring is steady and it's going to stay that way, so we want someone who'd rather go deep with a handful of engineering teams than churn through whatever's on fire this week. The tradeoff: you'll be expected to actually understand what you're hiring for and how your work impacts the business overall. You'll be a Talent Business Partner to the LiveKit team.

You'll thrive as a Senior Technical Recruiter if you:

  • are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

  • are focused on polish, detail and quality

  • are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement AI in the recruiting process 😊

What You'll Do

  • Own 8-10 engineering and technical searches end to end, from kickoff to signed offer

  • Partner with engineering hiring managers on what the role really needs, and push back when the requirements don't match the market

  • Source hard: find the infra, backend, SDK, and AI engineers who aren't looking, and give them a reason to talk to us

  • Understand what candidates are motivated by and create a strategy to get them there

  • Build pipelines for the roles we hire for again and again, so new reqs don't start from zero

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Vulnerability Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About LiveKit

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

About This Role

Our customers trust us with audio, video and data belonging to their own end users, so a security failure on our side puts their data and their business at risk. We are hiring a Security Engineer to build and run our vulnerability management and security operations program. Vulnerability management is a core capability for keeping our security posture strong as the platform and the company grow: knowing what we run, finding what is exposed, and getting the right fixes shipped quickly. It also underpins our customer commitments and the compliance programs we are building. Our program is early, and you will shape it. You will join a small Trust team that covers security, IT and compliance, and you will own this program end to end from your first week.

You'll thrive at LiveKit if you

  • think like both a builder and a breaker, and understand security from first principles

  • take an automation-first and pragmatic approach to risk mitigation

  • translate security concerns into engineering action

  • can clearly explain complex technical concepts to others

  • are a fast learner and thrive in ambiguity

 

What You’ll Do

  • Select, deploy and operationalize scanning tooling across our production assets.

  • Run vulnerability management end to end: triage, severity in our environment, owner assignment, remediation SLAs and reporting.

  • Build engineering-first triage and remediation workflows that fit how our engineering teams already work, and automate the routing and follow-up.

  • Build a remediation dashboard that engineering and leadership read and act on.

  • Automate collection of the vulnerability management evidence our compliance programs depend on, in partnership with our Compliance team.

  • Build automation, including agentic tooling, that removes manual security operations work and keeps pace with engineering growth.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years in security engineering, security operations or software engineering, with a significant share of that focused on security.

  • Hands-on experience building or running a vulnerability management program or software security tooling (SCA, container, cloud or host scanning).

  • An engineering-first approach to triage and remediation: you get findings fixed by making the fix easy to ship.

  • The judgment to set a finding's real severity in our environment, using CVSS as one input.

  • Strong scripting and automation skills in a language such as Go or Python, and comfort reading infrastructure as code such as Terraform.

  • A pragmatic approach to risk: you can explain why a finding matters to the business and how fast it needs to be fixed.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with real-time media, networking or WebRTC systems.

  • Experience supporting compliance audits such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

  • Incident response or application security experience.

  • Experience in AI security, such as securing LLM applications or agent infrastructure.

Our Commitment to You

  • An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

  • Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

  • Competitive salary and equity package

  • Health, dental, and vision benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact recruiting@livekit.io.
